text:
samir: Hey team — kickoff for the new open-model supplier (HelioNet) onboarding. They want a hosted marketplace listing + an SI bundle with EdgeSI partner. Need licensing/redistribution clarity, KMS for weights, and an embargo window for the joint PR. :wave:
zoe: +1. Do we have the model's license file? GPL-compatible or custom?
morgan: They sent a custom dual-license PDF earlier, I'll repost. Short version: non-commercial research allowed; commercial requires marketplace redistribution addendum.
carmen: We need to confirm whether the addendum allows Dedicated and Private deployments (customer bringing their own infra). Legal implications differ. @linda-legal? :lock:
linda-legal: skimming it now. Initial read: redistribution allowed to SaaS marketplace, but rehosting by third parties requires explicit consent. We'll need a simple addendum: "redistribution-for-hosted-services" clause and a checkbox for SI reselling. I'll draft.
elliot: Tech note: the weights are in FP16 and a separate INT8 quantized bundle. We should list both SKUs; infra needs KMS-wrapped weights for private deployments. @ben-infra any concerns with key rotation?
ben-infra: KMS OK. For Private we require customer-provided KMS in the VPC flow; for Dedicated we host KMS-HSM or allow tenant-managed key. Need to confirm S3 object ACL and signed URL TTLs.
samir: Great — also product wants to bundle with EdgeSI hardware SKU (HW-Edge-XL). Marketplace listing should show latency/cost estimates for both cloud and edge. Who owns the joint announcement copy?
carmen: Partner marketing wants a co-branded one-pager. We should set an embargo date and a freeze for artifacts (docs, demo, release notes). Proposed timeline: legal signoff by Tue, infra integration by Fri, QA + perf benchmarks early next week, announcement two weeks out. Thoughts? :calendar:
zoe: timeline seems tight but doable. Can we carve out a canary listing (private preview) before public listing so SI partners can validate?
morgan: We can enable a private-marketplace draft SKU. It requires marketplace metadata JSON. Example metadata we can use for the draft: ```json
{
  "sku": "helionet-13b-fp16",
  "display_name": "HelioNet 13B (FP16)",
  "licensing": "partner-addendum-required",
  "deployment_modes": ["Hosted","Dedicated","Private-VPC"],
  "kms_required": true
}
```
elliot: Perf targets: 95th percentile < 220ms for short completion on Dedicated (batch=1), and edge latency per token TBD. We'll run workload tests once we have model artifact in staging.
linda-legal: Draft addendum posted in drive: https://drive.redwood/helionet-redistribution-addendum. I'll ping legal-engineering channel for final review. Note: export control clause needs the model origin asserted; supplier must provide provenance attestation.
ben-infra: One ops flag: for private deployments we should include an automated wipe-on-delete workflow for weights and cached KV to satisfy supplier privacy asks. I'll prepare an infra checklist.
samir: Marketing/PR: prefer joint blog + coordinated tweets. Recommend embargo at 2025-11-10 17:00 UTC. If legal or infra slips, fallback to a soft announcement (marketplace listing only) with no press.
carmen: We need logos, boilerplate, and a joint quote from HelioNet CEO. Requesting assets by EOD Wed.
morgan: Noted. I'll follow up with HelioNet for the CEO quote and provenance attestation form.
zoe: Can we assign owners: Legal = linda-legal, Infra = ben-infra, Product = samir, Sales/SI = carmen, Marketing = morgan, Engineering perf = elliot. I'll update the tracker. :white_check_mark:
announce-bot: Reminder: fill the marketplace metadata form: https://marketplace.redwood/new-sku — due 2025-11-03
samir: Thanks. Quick blockers?
linda-legal: Need supplier signature on addendum + provenance doc. If they push on rehost rights we'll require revenue share for SI resale.
ben-infra: Need artifact upload and KMS test from supplier staging by Thu.
elliot: Need short prompt set for perf evals — I'll send a seed set by tomorrow.
morgan: I'll chase assets and the CEO quote.
carmen: I'll coordinate SI partner (EdgeSI) to run integration smoke tests in private preview.
samir: Cool. If no objections, locking timeline. I'll post a small checklist doc later with owner tags. :thumbsup:
